newsitem.title: USA: Jackson, Slater to represent U.S. at Africa summit.
newsitem.headline: Jackson, Slater to represent U.S. at Africa summit.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will send a delegation led by civil rights leader Jesse Jackson and Transportation Secretary Rodney Slater to a Zimbabwe summit of Africans and black Americans, the White House said on Friday.
The Fourth African/African-American Summit is to be held in Zimbabwe's capital, Harare, on July 20-25.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Jackson and Slater will lead a delegation that will include high-level government officials, business leaders, non-governmental organisation representatives and religious leaders.

He said their active participation in the event builds on continuing efforts to expand a U.S. economic and political partnership with Africa, including Hillary Rodham Clinton's trip to Africa last spring.
"This summit provides a unique opportunity to strengthen U.S. bilateral relations and forge new ties between American and African individuals and companies," McCurry said.
